title.value: Choreomundus – Erasmus Mundus Master in Dance and Movement as Practical Knowledge and Heritage

description_short: Vytautas Magnus University lists the Choreomundus Erasmus Mundus master's in dance and movement heritage for the 2027-2028 autumn intake. Applications opened 15 October 2026 and close 15 January 2027 for Choreomundus applicants.
